args.code: (() => { const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab, .shop-tab, .nav-tab'); let tabTexts = []; for (let tab of tabs) { const text = tab.textContent.trim(); if (text) { tabTexts.push(text); } } const all = document.querySelectorAll('*'); let marketFound = false; for (let el of all) { const text = el.textContent.trim(); if (text.includes('集市') || text.includes('市场')) { marketFound = true; break; } } return JSON.stringify({tabs: tabTexts, marketFound: marketFound}); })()
